The '''Sesid system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sesid/Legends|Sesid]].
